name: scenario_NetworkReceive_two_boards
description: Two boards: the sender board sends with Network Send, this device receives with Network Receive. Sweeps grid size, identity against serpentine layout, mapped by the receiver against the sender, one layer against two, and the three protocols, reading Network Receive's tick and its packets and frames per second against what the sender sent.

steps.name: sender-clear-layouts
steps.description: The sender's canvas: one grid, one layer with a changing effect, and a Network Send aimed at the receiver.

steps.name: receiver-clear-layouts
steps.description: The receiver's canvas: one grid and one layer holding Network Receive; its own drivers stay, so the forward mapping is the real one.
